text:
Alex Chen: Customer report — tool call to /v1/tools/execute is returning 400 for malformed args. Customer: acme-data-prod. Seen across multiple regions.

Alex Chen: Repro payload they sent:
```
POST /v1/tools/execute
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tool": "pdf_extractor",
  "args": {
    "path": "s3://acme-bucket/invoice.pdf",
    "pages": [1,2,],
  },
  "request_id": "req-4b2f9"
}
```

Support Bot: API error -> 400 Bad Request: tool_args_parse_failed: invalid JSON at byte 124 (trailing comma)

Mira Patel: Can you paste the raw curl the customer used? Also which SDK/version? :eyes:

Alex Chen: They used our mobile SDK -> 1.3.2 and a server-side proxy that munges the body. Minimal repro that fails for me:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/execute" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"pdf_extractor","args":{"path":"s3://acme-bucket/invoice.pdf","pages":[1,2,],},"request_id":"req-4b2f9"}'
```

Sahil Rao: Got it. Reproduced locally, same error. Quick workaround: JSON.stringify on the client before sending or remove trailing commas. Looks like a library on their proxy is injecting trailing commas when merging arrays.

Ingrid Müller: Impact — affects 3 customers (reported) and one high-volume customer in prod. Escalating. Please create an internal incident and link to customer ticket INC-7591.

Jordan (oncall): Assigned to @Sahil Rao for triage + patch. Will open INC-7591 and set P1 if more customers surface. Next steps: reproduce in integration, add parser tolerant mode behind feature flag, log metric for tool_arg_parse_failed.

Sahil Rao: I'll add a short-term tolerant parser that strips trailing commas, then follow up with a proper fix (reject + clearer error + docs). ETA for patch: today EOD.

Mira Patel: Thanks, please update the incident with repro curl and the failing response. I'll notify support leads and post a workaround message to the affected customers. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Adding curl + response to the incident now. Thanks all.
